description: City of Port Phillip Community Bus Stops is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Port Phillip. Points showing locations of Community Bus stops within City of Port Phillip. The FREE Community Bus provides access for all to services throughout the City of Port Phillip. Buses are wheelchair-accessible, allowing many people who cannot access existing public transport services to be able to move around the municipality. Coverage: City of Port Phillip. The portal files it under the publisher City of Port Phillip. Its tags are Bus Stops, Commnunity, opencouncildata. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2022-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
